subject: Request: EOQ conversion credit for LuminaHealth (trial top-up)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: EOQ conversion credit for LuminaHealth (trial top-up)

Team —

Quick summary: LuminaHealth (pilot of our embeddings + retrieval stack) is verbally ready to convert but they need a last push to commit this quarter. They’ve been running a 30-day trial; usage ramped to ~350k tokens/day in week 3. Primary ask from the customer: a one-time credits package to cover the first 3 months as they onboard HIPAA compliance controls on their end.

Why this matters:
- ACV upside: base subscription + professional onboarding = ~$230k ARR in year 1 if they sign by 4/15.
- Churn risk reduced if we cover initial consumption and accelerate success.

Proposal (what I’m asking for):
- Approve a $25,000 Redwood credit applied to their first invoice (one-off, non-recurring).
- Condition: 12-month initial contract term and SSO + SOC 2 attestation milestone inside 60 days.
- Amend order form (SOW v3 attached) and send to Priya/Evan with DocuSign link.

Attached: Lumina-SOW-v3.pdf, credit-calculation.xlsx (breakdown of credits vs. estimated token spend).

If approved, I’ll own communication with the account and track the SOC 2 milestone. If you want to reduce the credit amount, say so and I’ll adjust the ask.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: EOQ conversion credit for LuminaHealth (trial top-up)

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear write-up. I’m comfortable supporting a credit here, but want to tighten the terms to protect our economics. Approveable subject to the following:

1) Reduce one-time credit to $20,000 (still generous but keeps ACV math healthy).
2) Require executed 12-month MSA/order form with minimum monthly committed spend of $8k for months 4–15 (to avoid back-loaded churn).
3) Credit applied over first two invoices (50/50) and explicitly non-transferable.

If the customer pushes back, escalate to me before offering more. Also please ensure legal stamps SOW v3 and we attach the standard credit addendum (I referenced it in the HubSpot deal).

I’m OK with you emailing the customer after confirming they accept the conditions. Grace — looped for visibility on onboarding resources and SOC 2 milestone tracking.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial wrap & next steps — credit proposal included

Evan / Priya —

Thanks again for the trial feedback — excited you saw value. Following internal review, Redwood can offer a one-time $20,000 onboarding credit to help cover initial consumption while you complete your compliance checks. A few items to confirm: 

- Credit: $20,000 applied across first two invoices (10k + 10k).
- Commitment: 12-month initial term with minimum monthly committed spend of $8,000 starting month 4.
- Milestone: SOC 2 attestation (or equivalent) to be completed within 60 days; Grace O'Connor will coordinate onboarding and compliance checkpoints.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send an amendment to the SOW (attached) via DocuSign for signatures reflecting the credit and the minimum monthly commitment. Link will arrive in the next hour: https://docusign.com/embedded-signing/ABCD-EF-4821
2) Once signed we’ll provision the credit and schedule a joint onboarding call between Lumina engineers and our solutions team (Grace will reach out to book).

If that works, please reply with a quick confirmation. If you’d like to propose alternative milestones (e.g., staged SOC evidence) we can discuss.

Best,
Karthik
